additionalAbilities.description: Shuu makes three Cleave attacks. One of them can be replaced with a Heavy Cleave attack, or he makes three Improvised Shot attacks, one of which can be replaced with an Improvised Heavy Shot attack.
additionalAbilities.name: Multiattack
Rage (3/Day)
Reckless Attack
Relentless Rage

additionalAbilities.description: When Shuu scores a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, he rolls two additional weapon damage dice.
additionalAbilities.name: Brutal Critical

additionalAbilities.description: Shuu has advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects he can see.
additionalAbilities.name: Danger Sense

additionalAbilities.description: Shuu has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of Shuu's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics

legendaryActions.description: Shuu moves up to half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then makes one Cleave attack.
legendaryActions.name: Charge (Costs 1 Action)
Warlord's Roar (Costs 1 Action)
Earthshaker Slam (Costs 2 Actions)

stats.legendaryActionsDescription: Shuu can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Spent legendary actions are regained at the start of his turn.

reactions.description: When Shuu takes damage from a creature within 5 ft. of him, he can use his reaction to make one Cleave attack against that creature.
reactions.name: Savage Retaliation
